newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Richemont suspended in SAfrica pending news.
newsitem.headline: Richemont suspended in SAfrica pending news.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange said on Friday it had suspended the listings of Richemont Securities AG, MIH Holdings Ltd and Omni Media Corp Ltd pending an announcement.
The decision follows a similar move earlier on Friday by the Swiss Stock Exchange to suspend Richemont trading in Zurich, where the company has its primary listing.

"An announcement by the companies will be made on or before Monday 9 September 1996 and their listings will be reinstated from the commencement of business on Monday 9 September 1996," the JSE said in a statement.
The suspension followed a request from the boards of the three companies.

The Wall Street Journal earlier said Hughes Electric Corp, a unit of General Motors, was in serious talks to invest as much as $1 billion for a 30-percent stake in the Netherlands' NetHold. Holding firm Nethold is half-owned by Richemont and MCL-Multi Choice Ltd.
MCL-Multi Choice, which recently changed its name to MIH Holdings, is 35-percent owned by Omni Media.
